title: Tiny, cute cactus in a pot
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- pot -->
  <path d='M30 72 L70 72 L64 92 L36 92 Z' fill='#E07030'/>
  <rect x='27' y='66' width='46' height='9' rx='4' fill='#F08848'/>
  <!-- pot rim highlight -->
  <rect x='27' y='66' width='46' height='4' rx='2' fill='#FFA870'/>
  <!-- soil -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='69' rx='19' ry='4' fill='#7A4A28'/>
  <!-- cactus body -->
  <rect x='42' y='30' width='16' height='40' rx='8' fill='#3CB85A'/>
  <!-- cactus left arm -->
  <path d='M42 52 Q32 52 32 44 Q32 38 38 38' stroke='#3CB85A' stroke-width='8' stroke-linecap='round' fill='none'/>
  <!-- cactus right arm -->
  <path d='M58 46 Q68 46 68 38 Q68 32 62 32' stroke='#3CB85A' stroke-width='8' stroke-linecap='round' fill='none'/>
  <!-- cactus highlights -->
  <rect x='45' y='34' width='4' height='30' rx='2' fill='#5AD878'/>
  <rect x='45' y='34' width='10' height='4' rx='2' fill='#5AD878'/>
  <!-- cactus darker shade edges -->
  <rect x='54' y='34' width='3' height='32' rx='1.5' fill='#2A9040'/>
  <!-- spines -->
  <line x1='44' y1='36' x2='41' y2='34' stroke='#C8F0A0' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='56' y1='38' x2='59' y2='36' stroke='#C8F0A0' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='44' y1='48' x2='41' y2='46' stroke='#C8F0A0' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='56' y1='52' x2='59' y2='50' stroke='#C8F0A0' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='44' y1='60' x2='41' y2='58' stroke='#C8F0A0' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='56' y1='64' x2='59' y2='62' stroke='#C8F0A0' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='32' y1='42' x2='29' y2='40' stroke='#C8F0A0' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='68' y1='36' x2='71' y2='34' stroke='#C8F0A0' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- flower -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='28' r='5' fill='#FF70A0'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='28' r='2.5' fill='#FFD040'/>
  <!-- pot drainage highlight stripe -->
  <rect x='38' y='76' width='24' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#F08848'/>
</svg>
